blocks.text: Match preview: Victoria face Western Australia in 11th Match (TEST) on Wed, 11 Nov, 2026, 5:00 am at Melbourne Cricket Ground Melbourne. Full pitch report, weather forecast, and squad details below.
Pace and bounce typical of Australian wickets; good carry for fast bowlers.
Drizzle · High 28°C / Low 10°C · Rain: 1.7 mm · Wind: up to 14 km/h. Light rain possible — overcast conditions could assist swing bowling early.
International playing XI is announced at the toss. Check back on match day for confirmed line-ups.
